log.label: E1
log.note: genesis: dev-mac self-signed, recovery key pinned

log.label: E5
log.note: add service svc-discord, signed by dev-phone, expires 30 days after signed_at

name: r9-vectors-membership-log
note: Log L: E1..E6, head (6, E6.entry_hash). Signing input = enc(["atem-membership-entry-v1", jcs(body)]); entry_hash = hex(SHA-256(enc(["atem-membership-hash-v1", jcs(body)]))) (the signature is not hashed). P-256 signatures are RFC 6979 deterministic here, normalized to low S; verifiers accept any valid low-S signature. Recovery decisions (R9.5): recovery_approve / recovery_veto name the pending entry's entry_hash in target; set_recovery_key carries recovery_key and kit (current | lost), and with kit current a kit_sig beside sig: Ed25519 by the current recovery key over enc(["atem-recovery-cosign-v1", jcs(body)]) (not hashed, like sig). k_backup (R9.5) records {blob_version, kids, recovery_key, backup_hash} of the newest K backup. SUB1-SUB3 are a substitute chain (another genesis reusing kit 1's public key) that a restore must refuse because its genesis differs from the kit's.

others.label: C6_ipad
others.note: conflicts with E6; signed by dev-ipad, which E6 removes: ignored, logged

others.label: C6_mac
others.note: conflicts with E6; signed by dev-mac, still a manager at the head: freeze

others.label: S6_phone
others.note: honest sibling of E6 (dev-phone removes svc-discord on the same head); exists only if the relay's compare-and-swap failed

others.label: E7
others.note: dev-phone's append rebuilt on E6 after the relay's 409: remove svc-discord

others.label: E7_retry
others.note: same body as E7, another valid low-S P-256 signature (hedged nonce): same entry_hash, not a conflict

others.label: X8_badsig
others.note: chains from E7 but its signature is corrupted (last byte of the signature flipped): invalid

others.label: X7_ipad
others.note: beyond the head, signed by dev-ipad, removed at E6: invalid (signer not a manager at seq 6)

others.label: X5_svc91d
others.note: service expiry 91 days after signed_at: invalid (limit 90 days)

others.label: R7
others.note: recovery_add dev-newmac on E6, signed by the genesis recovery key

others.label: R7_wrong_key
others.note: the same body signed by another Ed25519 key: invalid

others.label: R7_roles
others.note: recovery_add whose roles are not exactly [control, manage, view]: invalid

others.label: R7_remove
others.note: a remove signed by the recovery key: invalid (the recovery signer may only recovery_add)

others.label: R6_conflict
others.note: recovery_add at seq 6 on E5: conflicts with E6; the recovery key is never removed, so a host holding E6 freezes

others.label: R7_backdated
others.note: recovery_add dev-newmac on E6 whose signed_at claims 3 days earlier: still waits 24 h from when the host first sees it

others.label: A8
others.note: recovery_approve of R7 by dev-mac: R7 takes effect at once

others.label: V8
others.note: recovery_veto of R7 by dev-phone: cancels R7 if it is still pending on the host

others.label: A8_ipad
others.note: recovery_approve of R7 by dev-ipad, removed at E6: invalid (signer not a manager at seq 7)

others.label: V8_ipad
others.note: recovery_veto of R7 by dev-ipad, removed at E6: invalid (signer not a manager at seq 7)

others.label: N8
others.note: dev-newmac (R7's subject) removes svc-discord: deferred while R7 is pending on the host, valid once R7 is in effect there

others.label: K7_current
others.note: set_recovery_key to kit 2, kit current: signed by dev-phone and co-signed (kit_sig) by the current recovery key: in effect at once

others.label: K7_current_no_kit_sig
others.note: K7_current's body without kit_sig: invalid (kit current needs the co-signature)

others.label: R8_oldkit
others.note: recovery_add dev-newmac on K7_current signed by the replaced recovery key: invalid (retired key)

others.label: R8_newkit
others.note: the same body as R8_oldkit signed by kit 2's key: valid, pending

others.label: K7_lost
others.note: set_recovery_key to kit 2, kit lost: signed by dev-phone only; pending for 24 h on the host clock

others.label: V8_k
others.note: recovery_veto of K7_lost by dev-mac: cancels it

others.label: A8_k_self
others.note: recovery_approve of K7_lost by dev-phone, its own signer: invalid (an approval needs another manager)

others.label: R8_oldkit_after_lost
others.note: recovery_add dev-newmac on K7_lost signed by the old recovery key: invalid once K7_lost is in effect (retired key)

others.label: KB7
others.note: k_backup by dev-mac on E6: env3_kit1 (blob_version 3) is the account's backup

others.label: KB8
others.note: k_backup by dev-mac on KB7 after a K rotation: env4_kit1 (blob_version 4, new kid 7a3c9e10 first)

others.label: KB8_stale
others.note: k_backup on KB7 naming blob_version 3 again: invalid (blob_version must increase)

others.label: SUB1
others.note: substitute genesis (Astation r4 review 1): self-signed by dev-evil, recovery_key = kit 1's public key; fully valid on its own, but its entry_hash is not the genesis_hash kit 1 carries (E1's), so a restore with kit 1 refuses it (genesis_mismatch)

others.label: SUB2
others.note: substitute chain: add_host host-a with the host-evil key, signed by dev-evil; valid in the substitute chain only

others.label: SUB3
others.note: substitute chain: k_backup naming the substitute backup (blob_version 1, K-evil sealed to kit 1), signed by dev-evil; the envelope opens with kit 1

others.label: KB8_badct
others.note: k_backup by dev-mac on KB7 naming k_backup_bad_ct (version 4, last ciphertext byte flipped): a valid entry whose hash matches its envelope, which then fails to open (backup_invalid)

others.label: P7_add_host_b
others.note: add_host host-b (host_trust_gen 1, key "host-b host_channel_key") on E6, signed by dev-mac: the second host the project vectors need (a project lists at least two); host-b is authorized(7), membership epoch 7

others.label: P8_set
others.note: project_set "astation" on P7_add_host_b: hosts host-a and host-b, ops launch, message, notify, prompt; each host may send the other those ops, and a host itself gets none

others.label: P9_narrow
others.note: project_set "astation" on P8_set with ops [message] only: the body is the project's whole new state and replaces P8_set's (a narrowing)

others.label: P10_remove
others.note: project_remove "astation" on P9_narrow: no project is in effect

others.label: P11_remove_again
others.note: project_remove "astation" on P10_remove: invalid (no project of that name in effect): not_a_project

others.label: P9_bad_project
others.note: project_set "astation" on P8_set with ops [notify, prompt]: invalid (notify needs message and prompt): bad_project

others.label: P7_not_a_host
others.note: project_set "astation" listing host-a and host-b on E6, where host-b was never added: invalid (every listed host must be current): not_a_host

others.label: P9_remove_host_b
others.note: remove_host host-b on P8_set: host-b leaves every project at once; "astation" stays in effect (as signed it still lists host-b) with host-a its only member, so it grants nothing between host-a and host-b; host-b stays authorized(7) with no membership epoch

others.label: P10_readd_host_b
others.note: add_host host-b again (host_trust_gen 2, key "host-b host_channel_key gen 2") on P9_remove_host_b: a current host again, membership epoch 10, but in no project until a new project_set lists it

others.label: P11_set_again
others.note: project_set "astation" on P10_readd_host_b with the same project state as P8_set: valid as a new entry; host-b is a member again

others.label: P10_remove_host_a
others.note: remove_host host-a on P9_remove_host_b: no member of "astation" is left, yet the project stays in effect (set and not removed)

others.label: P11_remove_emptied
others.note: project_remove "astation" on P10_remove_host_a: valid (a project whose members all left through remove_host is in effect until removed)

others.label: P9_reverify_a
others.note: add_host host-a at host_trust_gen 2 (a re-verification, key "host-a host_channel_key gen 2") on P8_set, with no remove_host: host-a stays in "astation" and keeps membership epoch 2

others.label: EK7_set
others.note: host_enc_key host-a (host_trust_gen 1) on E6: enc_key "host-a host_enc_key 1", enc_sig by host-a's host_key over enc_sig_input_hex, no retire_previous: host-a's current key

others.label: EK8_rotate
others.note: a routine rotation on EK7_set: "host-a host_enc_key 2" current; host_enc_key 1 kept as the previous key, not retired (the host still opens mail with it for 24 h on its own clock)

others.label: EK9_rotate_retire
others.note: a rotation with retire_previous: true on EK8_rotate (a suspected compromise): host_enc_key 3 current, host_enc_key 2 the previous key and retired at once; host_enc_key 1 is no longer kept (one previous key only)

others.label: EK7_retire_first
others.note: host_enc_key host-a with retire_previous: true and no previous key, on E6: valid; host_enc_key 1 current, nothing to retire

others.label: EK8_same_key
others.note: host-a's current key (host_enc_key 1) set again with retire_previous: true on EK7_set: invalid (the previous key would be the live one, same kid, and retired): same_enc_key

others.label: EK8_bad_enc_sig
others.note: host_enc_key 2 on EK7_set carrying the enc_sig of host_enc_key 1's binding: invalid (enc_sig doesn't verify over enc_sig_input_hex with host-a's host_key): bad_enc_sig

others.label: EK8_retire_false
others.note: host_enc_key 2 on EK7_set with retire_previous: false: invalid (the field is present only as true; false is omitted, one form per meaning): malformed

others.label: EK8_reverify_a
others.note: add_host host-a at host_trust_gen 2 (atem pair verify, key "host-a host_channel_key gen 2") on EK7_set: voids host-a's encryption keys until an entry for generation 2

others.label: EK9_stale_gen
others.note: host_enc_key for host_trust_gen 1 (host_enc_key 2, enc_sig by the generation-1 key) on EK8_reverify_a: invalid (not the newest add_host's generation): host_trust_gen_not_current

others.label: EK9_set_gen_2
others.note: host_enc_key for host_trust_gen 2 on EK8_reverify_a: enc_key "host-a host_enc_key 3", enc_sig by the generation-2 key; current, with no previous key (none carries over a newer add_host)

others.label: EK7_not_a_host
others.note: host_enc_key host-b on E6, where host-b was never added (enc_sig by "host-b host_channel_key"): invalid: not_a_host

others.label: HS7_revoke
others.note: host_sender_revoke host-a, interrupt_running false, on E6: host-a goes from authorized(2) (its first add_host, E2) to revoked(7)

others.label: HS8_revoke_again
others.note: host_sender_revoke host-a on HS7_revoke (a revoke in revoked): invalid: already_revoked

others.label: HS7_readmit_authorized
others.note: host_sender_readmit host-a on E6 (a readmit in authorized): invalid: not_revoked

others.label: HS7_readmit_unknown
others.note: host_sender_readmit host-b on E6, where host-b was never added: invalid (only a revoked host is readmitted): not_revoked

others.label: HS7_revoke_unknown
others.note: host_sender_revoke host-b on E6, where no add_host names host-b: invalid: unknown_host

others.label: HS8_readmit
others.note: host_sender_readmit host-a on HS7_revoke: authorized(8), for work signed at or after seq 8 only

others.label: HS8_reverify_a
others.note: add_host host-a at host_trust_gen 2 (a re-verification, no removal) on HS7_revoke: host-a stays revoked(7) and keeps membership epoch 2

others.label: HS9_remove_host_a
others.note: remove_host host-a on HS8_reverify_a: still revoked(7); no membership epoch while removed

others.label: HS10_readd_host_a
others.note: add_host host-a again at host_trust_gen 3 (key "host-a host_channel_key gen 3") on HS9_remove_host_a: still revoked(7); membership epoch 10

others.label: HS11_readmit
others.note: host_sender_readmit host-a on HS10_readd_host_a: only a native manager's readmit admits it again: authorized(11)

others.label: HS12_revoke_interrupt
others.note: host_sender_revoke host-a, interrupt_running true, on HS11_readmit: revoked(12); its running turns are interrupted too

others.label: HS7_remove_host_a
others.note: remove_host host-a on E6: host-a can't send (not a current host), its sending state stays authorized(2), no membership epoch

others.label: HS8_revoke_removed
others.note: host_sender_revoke host-a on HS7_remove_host_a: valid (an add_host names host-a, current or removed): revoked(8)
